name: Ca nuong up chau
summary: Cá nướng úp chậu is fish cooked under an upturned basin, not over an open flame. VnExpress and Dân trí describe golden skin, crisp like grilled squid, and firm sweet flesh, at a family table in the first days of the lunar year. Báo Nam Định on 25 November 2022 places an OCOP product at Trực Ninh. Both stay. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định. VnExpress, 18 March 2016, and Dân trí, 4 March 2017, for the home table. Trực Ninh on the 25 November 2022 OCOP list.
texture: When it is done, the skin is golden and crisp-chewy, and the flesh is firm and sweet.
howToEat: At the family table in the first days of the lunar year. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: A Nam Định home on the 2016 and 2017 accounts. Trực Ninh on the OCOP line. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca nuong up chau — fish under a basin
seoDescription: Fish grilled under an upturned basin at Tết, and named as an OCOP product at Trực Ninh. A price is Check on arrival.
